title: INL Computing Facility becomes DOE-NE user facility, launches Arco
html:
The Department of Energy’s Office of Nuclear Energy has designated the Idaho National Laboratory Computing Facility (INLCF) as an official user facility, making it the first such facility in the United States for high-performance computing focused on nuclear energy research.

Christian Natoni, the deputy manager for facilities, programs, and partnerships at the DOE Idaho Operations Office, said, “Making these computing resources available as a DOE Office of Nuclear Energy user facility gives researchers across the nuclear energy community access to capabilities they need to tackle complex challenges.”
summary: DOE’s Office of Nuclear Energy has made the Idaho National Laboratory Computing Facility an official user facility, the first US high-performance computing facility focused on nuclear energy research.
